verdict.rationale: Attio enables people and companies objects by default and links objects through a graph data model, so contacts and companies can be managed as linked records. Marketing claims cover a full history of every interaction, contact syncing and automatic call logging, which together suggest a per-record activity timeline. missing for 10: in-depth docs on the per-record activity timeline (what activity types appear and how), explicit documentation of the person-to-company relationship, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
